memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped. At the Lord's command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp. - Num 9:17-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Israel's movements were entirely governed by the cloud. When it lifted, they packed up and moved. When it settled, they made camp. They did not decide their own route or schedule; they simply followed God's lead, step by step.

What a picture of a life surrendered to God's guidance. The people did not run ahead of the cloud, impatient to move, nor did they lag behind when it lifted. They watched, they waited, and they followed. Their whole journey was shaped by God's direction, not their own plans.

This is how God invites us to live too — attentive to His leading, ready to move when He moves, willing to stay when He says stay. We so often want to chart our own course and ask God to bless it. But the better way is to seek His direction first and then follow, wherever it leads.

Following God requires trust. Sometimes the cloud would settle in a place that seemed uncomfortable, and Israel had to stay. Sometimes it would lift when they had just grown settled, and they had to move on. Either way, the call was the same: follow the Lord.

Jesus calls us simply to "follow me" (Matt 4:19). We may not always understand where He is leading, but we can trust the One who leads. He has promised to guide His people and never to leave them.

Are you following God's lead today, or running ahead on your own plans?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you seek God's guidance first, or ask Him to bless your own plans?
- Are you willing to move when He moves and wait when He waits?
- Where do you need to follow God's lead right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, teach me to follow Your lead — to move when You move and to wait when You wait. Help me to trust Your guidance even when I don't understand. Amen.
